title: workspace resources summary omits supported disk configuration
expected: The command summary identifies RAM, retained disk allowance, and vCPUs as configurable resources.
observed: The summary mentions only RAM and vCPUs even though the same help output exposes a --disk flag.

title: Command groups silently accept unknown subcommands
expected: Unknown subcommands are rejected with a nonzero exit and an unknown-command error.
observed: Both workspace and auth accept an arbitrary unknown subcommand, print parent help, and exit successfully.
